# dsh-plugin-example
A DeepSeek Harness plugin in ~70 lines: one sidebar tab that says hello and counts clicks. It exists
to be read, copied, and installed in one command.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it shows
| Piece | Where | Why it is worth copying |
| The bundle envelope | `client.js` first and last lines | A client plugin is one file calling `wind

ow.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. No bundler, no relative imports. |
| The tab | `apply()`
→ `sidebarRightTabs.register` | `kind` is what the tab is opened by; `title` is a **function**, bec

ause it is re-read when the language changes. |
| The body | `slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.right.

pane.tab', key })` | The host injects the pane; you render its contents and inherit its theme. |
| T
wo languages | `COPY` + `ctx.locale.register` | Keys missing from one language fall back to the othe

r, so a half-translated plugin still renders. |
| The host half | `index.js` | Empty here on purpose
: a plugin with nothing to serve does not need routes. |

## FAQ

**Does it need a build step?**
No. `client.js` is the file the host loads: it calls
`window.__Module

Loader__.load({ id, factory })` and gets React through the
host's module loader. There is no bundler
and no build output to commit.

**The tab does not appear. What should I check?**
The tab registers as `kind: 'example'` in the righ

t sidebar, so look there
first. It requires harness `>=0.2.0` (the first version with
`sidebarRightT
abs`). To see what the host would render without the harness:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Why does the click count start over at zero?**
`clicks` is a local `useState` in `Panel`, so it ex

ists only while the tab is
mounted. Closing the tab or reloading the window starts a fresh count; th

is
example does not persist it.

**Can I run the example against my own bundle?**
Yes — `examples/render.mjs` takes a path:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Your bundle needs a `[data-testid="bump"]` button for the click step; remove
that block from `exampl
es/render.mjs` if it does not have one.

**Does it need network access, an API key, or extra permissions?**
No. `client.js` and `index.js` ma

ke no network calls and read no environment
variables. The dependencies are dev-only, for the test a

alls and read no environment
variables. The dependencies are dev-only, for the test and the example.
## Requirements

| Harness | `>=0.2.0` (the version that ships `sidebarRightTabs`) |
| Node | `>=18`, for the test on

ly |
| Permissions | none: no network, no key, no telemetry |
